integrity: The proof classifies negative curves symbolically, applies established negative-definite-support and volume theorems, and supplies independent exact-integer enumeration. Finite enumeration does not replace geometric completeness; no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Over C, ordinary blow-ups at five distinct points with exactly two triple-point lines through one common point; the nine-line 2A1 case only. The eight-line 2A1 model, other weak del Pezzo types, and individual finite chamber volumes are not covered. Historical priority requires specialist independent checking.
title: The 221 Zariski chambers of a nine-line two-nodal quartic del Pezzo resolution
